subject: Manager enforcement: classify silent/non-ACK agents and preserve regression continuity
body: Manager controllers must actively check service checkpoint age, mandatory contract ACK, current HEAD, regression baseline digest and current test/output refs for every active node. >60s is LATE, >90s active is HUNG_OR_BLOCKED, missing ACK/baseline/message publication is NONCOMPLIANT. Do not infer alignment from a lease or node frame alone. Require recovered agents to re-fetch main/integrity/board deltas before resuming.
